generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The tender should have executed in any one year the following minimum quantities of works usually 50% of the annual requirement of 100mm dia and above DI pipe-359Rmt, 150mm dia and above DI pipe-405 Rmt.
Works for which tenders already submitted details should be uploaded in Kppl portal
Contractors should have Civil contractor registration in BWSSB or KPWD/KUWSDB, etc
The Tenderer should have satisfactorily completed one similar work to an extent of 25% of the cost of the respective works. i.e., Rs. 20.82 Lakhs.
Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities usually 30% of the amount of contract i.e., Rs. 24.98 Lakhs.
Existing commitments and on going Works should be uploaded in Kppp portal
Qualification Information of clause 1.3(A) &(B) are mandatory.

The Tenderer Should have a in the last 5 years period achieved in at least two financial years an average turnover of not less than estimated cost of the respective works (Profit & loss account, Balance sheet certified/Audited by chartered accountant)..i.e., Rs. 83.27 Lakhs
